title: Function Health advisory board
description: A serif heading with an italic phrase and a lead line over a sideways rail of square portraits (6px corners) with a semibold name and a light two-line bio. On desktop the last visible card fades out and a round outlined arrow button scrolls the rail; on phones the rail just swipes with snap.
notes: the arrow button scrolls by one card with smooth scrolling (instant under reduced motion)
